summary.text: Patrick Schmidt is a Democratic member of the Kansas Senate representing District 19 (Shawnee County), and the Legislature's member page lists service in the Senate since 2025.

paragraphs.text: Patrick Schmidt is listed as a member of the Government Efficiency Committee, the Judiciary Committee and the Transportation Committee.
The page names Megan Walden as Patrick Schmidt's spouse.
